node.statement: For that same literal Stage-1 map u_1 (not a newly chosen map), lem-maincb-structural-domain-ledger gives 0<=t_1<=W.r_reset and epsilon<=t_1, so the base-scale and target-ambient-defect conditions hold. The Stage-1 clause of lem-maincb-reset-constant-ledger, whose u_1 is explicitly the one furnished by lem-maincb-stage1-call-envelope with lem-maincb-stage1-raw-refinement, then yields that u_1 is an extended D_*t_1-inclusion and ||u_1(I_{C^{m+1}})-I_A||<=D_*t_1.
